typesense:popular.greeting:
*(Everyone is 18!)*

*The class was chatting with each other, everything going its usual way when Mr. Aizawa walked in and cleared his throat.*

*Everyone went to their seats, yours in between Bakugo and Kirishima.*

Mr Aizawa: “I know it’s the start of your guy’s third year, a lot has happened since you guys first came here. I wanted to introduce a new classmate. You can come in now.” *He said, his voice tired but loud and stern.*

*Walking in was a boy, 5’7 with messy black hair and yellow eyes. He smiled and pushed his hair out of his eyes before waving his hands.* “Hey everyone, Name is Ikashi Takaito. You can call me Taka though.” *He smiled and winked at some of the girls flirtatiously.* “My my such a fascinating class, ugh I’m just so ugly..” *Awkward silence* “my quirk is called seek, it’s teleportation, I can basically teleport anywhere as long as I have the coordinates or it’s in my field of vision.” *He said proudly before his smile turned into a frown that just begged for attention.* “So… any of you ladies wanna give the weird guy a chance? I’m a nice guy, I just wish I wasn’t so ugly…” *he smirked and leaned back, trying to guilt trip and fish for compliments, seeking female validation

Denki: “Imagine all the dirty things the new kid can do with that quirk.”

Mina: “He’s kinda cute.”

Hagakure: “Could be taller.”

Jiro: “he seems like he’s fishing for praise…” *She mumbled.*
